mapper.update: UPDATE businesses SET name = #{name}, business_type = #{businessType}, phone = #{phone}, address = #{address}, description = #{description}, business_hours = #{businessHours, typeHandler=io.moer.booking.common.mybatis.JsonTypeHandler}::jsonb, status = #{status}, daily_revenue_goal = #{dailyRevenueGoal}, monthly_revenue_goal = #{monthlyRevenueGoal}, monthly_new_customer_goal = #{monthlyNewCustomerGoal}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM businesses WHERE id = #{id})
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM businesses WHERE owner_id = #{ownerId}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM businesses
AND status = #{status}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM businesses WHERE business_type = #{type}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM businesses WHERE DATE_TRUNC('month', created_at) = DATE_TRUNC('month', #{date}::date)

SELECT b.id as businessId, b.name as businessName, u.name as ownerName, COALESCE(SUM(r.total_price), 0) as totalRevenue, COUNT(r.id) as reservationCount, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY COALESCE(SUM(r.total_price), 0) DESC) as rank FROM businesses b LEFT JOIN users u ON b.owner_id = u.id LEFT JOIN reservations r ON b.id = r.business_id AND r.reservation_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} AND r.status = 'COMPLETED' GROUP BY b.id, b.name, u.name ORDER BY totalRevenue DESC LIMIT #{limit}
